description: Frozen 152-unit census. Stages 1-6 have verified Rust implementations for 77 units (50.66% by unit count); native C++ adapters remain.

counting_rules.denominator: 152 frozen direct C++ implementation units; baseline_cpp_lines are from the frozen census, not current source sizes.
counting_rules.migrated: Count only verified portable implementation ports. A C++ adapter remains at each boundary; builtin aggregation wrappers, assembly, headers, and third-party code are not counted as migrated.
counting_rules.pending: A selected unit is counted only after differential, linked-DLL, and integration checks pass. Unit coverage is not a measure of effort or full DLL completion.
